title: When Does Inexact Matching Ensure Balance and Inference without Adjustment?
abstract: arXiv:2610.10873v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: One-to-one matching without replacement is a classical approach to constructing comparable treated and control samples in the design of observational studies. It pairs each treated unit with a distinct control while minimizing a covariate distance objective. With continuous covariates, the matched pairs generally remain inexact, which contributes to bias in downstream analysis. Its key theoretical properties, such as the resulting imbalance between matched pairs and when it is negligible to support valid inference, remain unclear. In this paper, we analyze one-to-one matching based on $d$-dimensional, continuous covariates with a quadratic covariate-distance objective. First, we find that when $d\leq 3$, under standard conditions on the propensity score ensuring abundant control samples near each treated sample, the imbalance (difference between within-group averages) is root-$n$ negligible uniformly over the family of smooth functions

translated_title: 不精确匹配何时能确保平衡及无需调整的推断？
translated_abstract: 无放回的一对一匹配是观察性研究设计中构建可比的处理组与控制组样本的经典方法。它将每个处理单元与一个不同的控制单元配对，同时最小化协变量距离目标。当协变量为连续变量时，匹配得到的配对通常仍是不精确的，这会在后续分析中引入偏差。然而，其关键理论性质，例如匹配对之间产生的失衡程度，以及该失衡何时可以忽略以支持有效推断，至今仍不清楚。在本文中，我们分析了基于 $d$ 维连续协变量、采用二次协变量距离目标的一对一匹配。首先，我们发现当 $d \leq 3$ 时，在确保每个处理样本附近有充足控制样本的倾向得分标准条件下，失衡（组内均值之差）在光滑函数族上一致地具有根号 $n$ 级别的可忽略性。
tldr: 该论文证明了在协变量维度不超过 3 维且倾向得分满足标准条件时，基于连续协变量的一对一匹配所产生的匹配对失衡具有根号 $n$ 级别的可忽略性，因而无需进一步调整即可进行有效的统计推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that for one-to-one matching on continuous covariates, when the dimension is at most 3 and standard propensity score conditions hold, the matched-pair imbalance is root-n negligible uniformly over smooth functions, enabling valid inference without further adjustment.
